appearance:
Appearance

Each part of the chart has its own settings. XAxis and YAxis set the scale, title, tick labels, baseline, and grid. Legend sets the display mode, position, alignment, and swatch shape. Tooltip sets the surface, the text colors, and the crosshair. Tooltip.ContentFunc names a global JS function that returns the tooltip HTML for the hovered row, and it replaces the default title and rows.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeArea,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{
		RowKey:             "month",
		IsTickStartEndOnly: true,
		TickLabelColor:     "secondary-300",
	},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "received", Label: "Received", IdentityColor: "secondary-500"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Cartesian: uiDisplay.ChartCartesianSettings{
		YAxis: uiDisplay.ChartYAxisSettings{
			Position:         uiDisplay.ChartYAxisPositionRight,
			IsGridLineHidden: true,
		},
		AreaFillStyle: uiDisplay.ChartAreaFillStyleSolid,
	},
	Legend: uiDisplay.ChartLegendSettings{
		DisplayMode: uiDisplay.ChartLegendDisplayModeAlways,
		Position:    uiDisplay.ChartLegendPositionBottom,
		Alignment:   uiDisplay.ChartLegendAlignmentEnd,
		SwatchShape: uiToolset.ShapeSquare,
	},
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{
		BackgroundColor:   "secondary-950/95",
		ValueColor:        "secondary-200",
		RingColor:         "secondary-500/40",
		IsCrosshairHidden: true,
		ContentFunc:       "chartDemoTooltipContent",
	},
	Rows: chartDemoMonthlyTrafficRows(),
})

bar:
Bar

Bar groups the series side by side for each XAxis.RowKey value. Each bar has its own tooltip.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeBar,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "month"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "received", Label: "Received (GiB)"},
		{RowKey: "transmitted", Label: "Transmitted (GiB)"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Cartesian: uiDisplay.ChartCartesianSettings{
		YAxis: uiDisplay.ChartYAxisSettings{TickLabelFormat: ",.0f"},
	},
	Rows: chartDemoMonthlyTrafficRows(),
})

donut:
Donut

Donut reads one value per row from the first series. XAxis.RowKey names the slice, and the legend lists the slices in row order. Donut.SliceIdentityColors sets the color of a slice by its name.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeDonut,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "service"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "usedGib", Label: "Storage (GiB)"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{ValueFormat: ",.1f"},
	Donut: uiDisplay.ChartDonutSettings{
		SliceIdentityColors: map[string]string{"mariadb": "sky-500"},
		HolePercent:         70,
	},
	Rows: []map[string]any{
		{"service": "mariadb", "usedGib": 42.5},
		{"service": "nginx", "usedGib": 3.2},
		{"service": "php-webserver", "usedGib": 18.9},
		{"service": "redis", "usedGib": 6.4},
	},
})

donut-center-label:
Donut Center Label

Donut.CenterLabelDisplayMode shows the slice name and its value in the donut hole. Always keeps the CenterLabelAlwaysSlice value, or the first slice when it is empty, until a hover replaces it. Hover shows the label only while a slice is hovered. CenterLabelSize scales both lines, and CenterLabelValueSuffix follows the value.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeDonut,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "service"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "usedGib", Label: "Storage (GiB)"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Tooltip: uiDisplay.ChartTooltipSettings{ValueFormat: ",.1f"},
	Donut: uiDisplay.ChartDonutSettings{
		CenterLabelDisplayMode: uiDisplay.ChartDonutCenterLabelDisplayModeAlways,
		CenterLabelAlwaysSlice: "mariadb",
		CenterLabelSize:        uiDisplay.ChartDonutCenterLabelSizeLg,
		CenterLabelValueSuffix: " GiB",
		HolePercent:            70,
	},
	Rows: []map[string]any{
		{"service": "mariadb", "usedGib": 42.5},
		{"service": "nginx", "usedGib": 3.2},
		{"service": "php-webserver", "usedGib": 18.9},
		{"service": "redis", "usedGib": 6.4},
	},
})

empty-state:
Empty State

With no rows, the chart shows EmptyState over the plot. The default is the text No data.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:   uiDisplay.ChartTypeArea,
	XAxis:  uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "time"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{{RowKey: "requests", Label: "Requests"}},

	// OptionalFields
	EmptyState: chartDemoEmptyState(),
})

line:
Line

A category axis shows the XAxis.RowKey values in row order. LineDashStyle draws a dashed series. Cartesian.MarkerDisplayMode always shows a marker on each point.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeLine,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "month"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "received", Label: "Received (GiB)"},
		{
			RowKey:        "transmitted",
			Label:         "Transmitted (GiB)",
			LineDashStyle: uiDisplay.ChartLineDashStyleDashed,
		},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Cartesian: uiDisplay.ChartCartesianSettings{
		YAxis:             uiDisplay.ChartYAxisSettings{Title: "GiB", TickLabelFormat: ",.0f"},
		MarkerDisplayMode: uiDisplay.ChartMarkerDisplayModeAlways,
	},
	Rows: chartDemoMonthlyTrafficRows(),
})

stacked:
Stacked

Cartesian.StackMode stacked piles the series on each other. Cartesian.StackMode percent shows each series as a share of the total, and the Y axis switches to percent. IdentityColor takes a color token for the series line, area, bar, marker, legend swatch, and tooltip swatch.

Usage 

@uiDisplay.Chart(uiDisplay.ChartSettings{
	Type:  uiDisplay.ChartTypeBar,
	XAxis: uiDisplay.ChartXAxisSettings{RowKey: "month", Title: "Month"},
	Series: []uiDisplay.ChartSeriesSettings{
		{RowKey: "received", Label: "Received", IdentityColor: "sky-500"},
		{RowKey: "transmitted", Label: "Transmitted", IdentityColor: "amber-500"},
	},

	// OptionalFields
	Cartesian: uiDisplay.ChartCartesianSettings{StackMode: uiDisplay.ChartStackModePercent},
	Rows:      chartDemoMonthlyTrafficRows(),
})
